scope: Agent source comparison of all 20 generated drafts, not independent human review.

issues.body: Please confirm whether you require a photo of my ID card in addition to the receipt ID.
issues.reason: require and required are the same requested information; receipt ID is context, not a separate request.

issues.body: Please provide the complete list of required documents in addition to the receipt ID.
issues.reason: complete list / in addition asks the explicitly missing documents, equivalent to full list / additional.

notes: F06 asks which stated fee applies; it does not independently ask approval status. F07 keeps the genuinely unresolved card/account conflict.
F11/F12 known receipt ID is identifying context; neither asks whether that ID is needed again.
The reviewer contrast suite is separately evaluated; a passing generated draft does not prove every bad draft is rejected.
